name: accountabilabuddy
description: Lightweight habit accountability for supportive groups

scripts.build: npm run build -w @accountabilabuddy/shared && npm run build -w @accountabilabuddy/api && npm run build -w @accountabilabuddy/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @accountabilabuddy/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c teal,cyan "npm run dev -w @accountabilabuddy/api" "npm run dev -w @accountabilabuddy/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @accountabilabuddy/shared && npm run test -w @accountabilabuddy/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @accountabilabuddy/shared && npm run lint -w @accountabilabuddy/api && npm run lint -w @accountabilabuddy/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @accountabilabuddy/shared && npm run typecheck -w @accountabilabuddy/api && npm run typecheck -w @accountabilabuddy/web
